name: Integra Capital Ltd.
summary: Integra Capital Ltd. operates as a non-deposit-taking entity specializing in the management of wealth and assets. The company actively allocates capital to various financial instruments, including shares, equities, mutual funds, and fixed deposits. Furthermore, it provides expert consultancy and advisory services to its clients. Tarun Vohra established the firm on May 2, 1990, and its primary operations are based out of New Delhi, India.
